headline: Mexico and India Launch Formal Bilateral Trade Negotiations
summary: Mexico and India have officially started formal trade negotiations following an agreement reached by President Claudia Sheinbaum and Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
why: Bilateral trade agreements can lower tariffs, expand market access, and reorient supply chains between major emerging markets.

impacts.name: Mexico
impacts.why: Formal trade talks could increase long-term trade flows and investment between Mexico and India.
